comment: GOLD drive fleet-boot manifest. When the GOLD drive is plugged in, gold-fleet-boot.mjs reads this and starts the enabled tiers in order. Cloud tier is DISABLED by default and HARD-GATED on a budget cap.

offline.desc: open the GOLD game launcher (no deps, no spend)

local.desc: live vault server + local fleet supervisor + orchestrator health (no spend)

cloud.desc: wake the vast.ai GPU fleet (SPENDS MONEY). Disabled by default; refuses to run without a positive budget cap.
